answer: An agent marketplace requires each identity to lock a fixed bond in a vault for 30 days before it can bid on jobs. Signed commitments anchor accountability: if an agent signs two incompatible results for the same job, anyone can submit both signatures to slash its bond. This makes the market a less inviting oasis for sybils: running 1,000 eligible identities ties up 1,000 bonds, and provable cheating burns that capital.
